summary: Comprehensive testing of Brightluxx security hardening features - All critical security features working correctly

minor.issue: Console warning: Encountered two children with the same key 'new' in admin dashboard

passed_tests: 1. Admin Login (POST /api/admin/login) - returns token + refresh_token + admin info correctly
2. Admin /me (GET /api/admin/me) - returns admin email and role with valid Bearer token
3. Token Refresh (POST /api/admin/refresh) - returns new access token from refresh_token
4. Password Change (POST /api/admin/change-password) - full cycle: change, verify, revert works
5a. Password Change Validation - wrong current password returns 400
5b. Password Change Validation - short password (<8 chars) returns 400
6. Rate Limiting on Login - 5+ failed attempts triggers 429 Too Many Requests
7. Rate Limiting on Lead Submit - 10+ rapid submissions triggers 429
8. Image Upload (POST /api/admin/upload) - returns url + variants (thumbnail, medium WebP files)
10. Upload Validation - non-image files rejected with 400
11. Security Headers - X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, X-XSS-Protection all present
12. Admin Stats (GET /api/admin/stats) - returns products, inspirations, projects, leads counts
13. Frontend Admin Login Flow - login form works, redirects to /admin/dashboard
14. Frontend Admin Settings Page - password change form visible and functional
15. Public site home page loads correctly
